title: Climate & Energy — GRI 102 and GRI 103 (2025 editions)
description: Early-adoption preview of the GRI climate and energy disclosures that replace GRI 305-1 to 305-5 and GRI 302 from 1 January 2027.
effective_rule: GRI states that use of GRI 103: Energy 2025 is required for all reporting on energy published on 1 January 2027 or later, with earlier adoption encouraged; GRI 102: Climate Change 2025 takes effect on the same date. Some commentators describe the trigger as reporting periods beginning on or after that date — confirm against the official text for the report being assessed.

changes: Draft mapping of GRI 102-4 to 102-8, 102-10, 103-2 and 103-4 using 2016-edition element equivalents.

notes: Draft catalogue. Element definitions require verification against the official GRI 102 and GRI 103 texts before results are relied on.
